column20: What do we know so far? initial trigger event was a Distributed Denial-of-Service (DDoS) attack and an error in the implementation of defenses amplified the impact
column21: What do we know so far? Azure Front Door (AFD) and Azure Content Delivery Network (CDN) components performing below acceptable thresholds
column22: What happened? impact described as affecting a subset of Microsoft services globally
column23: What happened? impact described as global across a subset of Microsoft services and the Azure portal
column25: How did we respond? failovers to alternate networking paths to provide relief and a revised mitigation approach; full recovery at 19:43 UTC
column28: V1b=config_change from the side-effect impacts of the initial network configuration mitigation; V9 uses 19:43 UTC failure-rate recovery rather than the 20:48 UTC declaration
